summary: Papaya Growth Opportunity Corp. I (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting termination of its Business Combination Agreement with 2744026 Alberta Ltd. The Company sent a termination notice on June 12, 2026, alleging breaches by the SPAC under Section 9.1(f)(i). The SPAC disputes the termination and reserves all rights. No financial terms, premium, or dates were disclosed in this filing. The parties appear to be in a contractual dispute over the deal's status. The key risk-arb angle involves potential litigation or a renegotiated transaction; investors should watch for the SPAC's legal response and any subsequent deal revival.
